articles.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that on November 10, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Mirum’s Board of Directors granted inducement awards consisting of non-qualified stock options to purchase 26,126 shares of common stock and 34,386 restricted stock units (“RSUs”) to 17 new employees under Mirum’s 2020 Inducement Plan. The Compensation Committee of Mirum’s Board of Directors approved the awards as an inducement material to the new employees’ employment in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). Each stock option has an exercise price of $94.42 per share, which is equal to the closing price of Mirum’s common stock on November 10, 2026, and will vest over four years, with 25% of the underlying shares vesting on the one-year anniversary of the applicable vesting commencement date, and the balance of the underlying shares vesting monthly thereafter over 36 months, subject to the new employees’ continued service
articles.title: Mirum Pharmaceuticals Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)

articles.summary: – Phase 3 AZURE-4 primary endpoint of combined virologic response and ALT normalization at Week 24 achieved by 59% with brelovitug 300 mg once weekly – Brelovitug achieved 100% virologic response and 100% ALT normalization in patients with cirrhosis following up to 108 weeks of treatment, as presented at The Liver Meeting® – Favorable safety and tolerability profiles observed across all studies; no new safety signals – U.S. FDA BLA submission expected in H1 2027 Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that the primary endpoint was met in the Phase 3 AZURE-4 study evaluating brelovitug, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody that binds to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV).
